interface.shortDescription: Phone number for your AI agent
interface.longDescription: Give ChatGPT a phone number. Switchphone lets ChatGPT make and receive real phone calls and texts. Have it call to set appointments or navigate customer service lines, or set it up as an AI receptionist for your online business, built from a crawl of your website. Live transcripts let you monitor calls in real time and message the agent to guide the conversation. Every call transcript and SMS thread is saved and searchable. Calls and texts go out only with your confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Call 213-855-0688 to set up my AI receptionist.
Set up my AI receptionist from my website.
Check my recent calls and text threads for any open todos.
